description: Demolition and redevelopment of existing warehouse to provide two storey building comprising of four self contained flats (4 x 1 bed); separate amenity space; bin and cycle stores
decision_conditions:
<p style="margin-top:5.0pt;margin-right:46.85pt;margin-bottom:5.0pt;margin-left:
36.0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><span style="font-family: &quot;PT Sans&quot;, sans-serif;"><span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&nbsp;</span></span><!--[endif]--><span style="font-family: &quot;PT Sans&quot;, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">The
proposal, by reason of failure to provide 35 per cent&nbsp; family sized
units with 3 or more bedrooms including the provision of no family units on the
ground floor, would result in an inappropriate and inadequate housing
mix, having regard to the location of the site and the character of its
surroundings as well as the evidence of local need which identifies the need
for more larger family sized units, and would fail to create inclusive and
mixed communities contrary to the provisions of the NPPF 2006, policy H10 of the London Plan (2021) and policies HO1
and HO2 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</span><span style="font-family: &quot;PT Sans&quot;, sans-serif; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p style="margin-top:5.0pt;margin-right:46.85pt;margin-bottom:5.0pt;margin-left:
36.0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);"><span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><font face="PT Sans, sans-serif">&nbsp;</font></span></span><span style="font-family: &quot;PT Sans&quot;, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">&nbsp;Insufficient information has been provided regarding the impact of
the proposals on designated heritage assets to enable a comprehensive
assessment of the impact of the proposed development on adjacent listed
building at no. 33 and locally listed building at no. 37 &nbsp;. The proposal is therefore contrary to NPPF 2026, Policy
HC1 of the London Plan and Policies SP02 and HE1 of Harrow Local Plan
(2021-2041)<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p style="margin-top:5.0pt;margin-right:46.85pt;margin-bottom:5.0pt;margin-left:
36.0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18.0pt;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><font face="PT Sans, sans-serif">&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></span><span style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal;"> &nbsp;</span><!--[endif]--><span style="font-family: &quot;PT Sans&quot;, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">The
applicant has failed to demonstrate to the satisfaction of the Local Planning
Authority that car parking can be provided within the curtilage of the site to
meet the parking requirements in respect of the development, resulting in the
likely increase in parking on the public highway(s) which would be detrimental
to the free flow and safety of traffic on the neighbouring highway(s). The proposal
is therefore contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the NPPF 2026 and is contrary to Policy T6 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy M2
of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</span><span style="font-family:&quot;PT Sans&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;PT Sans&quot;, sans-serif;">The proposed development,
by reason of its siting close to mature trees off the site and the lack of
detailed information to demonstrate that the works would not impact on the
health of these trees, could potentially result in the loss of trees of amenity
value, and in this respect would fail to preserve or enhance the character or
appearance of Stanmore Hill Conservation Area, </span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: &quot;PT Sans&quot;, sans-serif; color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">contrary the design aspirations of the NPPF 2026,
Policy D6 of the London Plan, (2021) and Policies GR1 and G14 of Harrow Local
Plan (2021-2041)</span></p>
